written.Break the seals as instructed, defeat Ri: Break the seals as instructed, defeat Rimtori and make sure everyone obtains her head. Check the tome before leaving. If it already offers Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning, take that delivery manually now; otherwise the later catch-up returns after Ag'tor's reward.
written.Each player collects the four named tabl: Each player collects the four named tablets in the ruins and uses Izvi's trowel at buried treasure along the beach for 10 fragments. Work through the nearby object clusters together; these are ground interactions, not a five-person random-drop quota.
written.Return to the tome after handing {quest:: Return to the tome after handing An Explosive Gambit to Ag'tor if you could not take it earlier. This is a required prerequisite for the later Vek'zol group objective.
written.{npc:8576} receives Rimtori's head and s: Ag'tor receives Rimtori's head and sends you to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. Hand the tablets to Jediga and the beach fragments to Izvi while at the same hub.
written.{npc:8587}, {npc:247473} and {npc:8576}: Jediga, Izvi Gildfizz and Ag'tor Bloodfist are at Valormok. Keep Izvi's trowel. Forever's revised Betrayed starts here; the old letter from Belgrom is not required by this route.

steps.title: Start the five-player continuation
steps.note: This route starts after the previous Five Friends pack. The chapter ranges describe the lowest member's estimated progress; a 49-52 starting spread is supported. Forever has 40 quest slots. Start with at least 20 free slots; the required route peaks at 18 carried quests, with optional side quests using additional space. Keep the old Sunken Temple introduction and {item:12402} if already accepted, and keep the Uldaman Discs chain completed. Refresh the sleeping-bag buff at a convenient break.

goals.text: Gather the party and check quest-log space
Required elite and dungeon steps are for your five-player party. Optional starter checks never require camping, extra clears, or delaying everyone for a random drop.

steps.title: Enter {zone:1447} from {zone:1440}
steps.note: Find {npc:11548} beside the road just inside the {zone:1440}-{zone:1447} border. Starting with these lower-level kills reduces further quest-reward penalties for your highest members.

steps.title: Release the Highborne spirits
steps.note: At Shadowsong Shrine northeast of {npc:11548}, kill 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings. Keep everyone close enough for shared credit.

steps.title: Clear the Haldarr camp
steps.note: At Haldarr Encampment, finish 6 {npc:6125}, 2 Haldarr Tricksters and 2 {npc:6127}.

steps.title: Report to {npc:11548}
steps.note: Return to the roadside camp before heading north to Valormok.

steps.title: Collect the Valormok circuit
steps.note: {npc:8587}, {npc:247473} and {npc:8576} are at Valormok. Keep {npc:247473}'s trowel. Forever's revised {quest:3505} starts here; the old letter from Belgrom is not required by this route.

goals.text: If Blue Gold is offered while you collect local quests, it is an optional overlap: keep a naturally dropped wand for Ley of the Land, but do not farm it for five people.

steps.title: Speak with {npc:235903} in the ruins
steps.note: {npc:235903} is in the Ruins of Eldarath, not the Valormok quest hub. Take this before the northern Legashi circuit. This selection does not require Neutral Timbermaw reputation.

steps.title: Search Eldarath and the beach
steps.note: Each player collects the four named tablets in the ruins and uses {npc:247473}'s trowel at buried treasure along the beach for 10 fragments. Work through the nearby object clusters together; these are ground interactions, not a five-person random-drop quota.

goals.text: Keep a Horde Humongous Crystal if one happens to appear: item 246888 begins Pay Dirt! The dropper is not securely identified, so this guide adds no mob farm or speculative map pin.

steps.title: Find {npc:8420} above the northern camp
steps.note: Climb to {npc:8420}'s camp on the hill overlooking the northern blood-elf encampment before collecting the four supply items below.

steps.title: Thin the Legashi
steps.note: Kill 5 each of Legashi Satyr, Legashi Rogues and Legashi Hellcallers in northern {zone:1447}. A recorded concentration is around /mappin 1447 57.2 21.3. These are shared kill objectives.

steps.title: Combine blood-elf kills and supplies
steps.note: Kill 6 Blood Elf Reclaimers and 6 Blood Elf Surveyors. Each player also retrieves {npc:8420}'s compass, scope, stuffed chicken and wizzlegoober from the camp containers. Use the current Forever count of 6 each, not the older 10-each version.

steps.title: Return {npc:8420}'s property
steps.note: Climb back to {npc:8420}. Do not add his follow-up collection to the required route.

steps.title: Investigate the summoning tome
steps.note: Use the {npc:247449} beside Rimtori's circle: /mappin 1447 59.5 31.3. The tome is an interactable NPC in the database.

steps.title: Retrieve the three seals
steps.note: Find Magister Hawkhelm around /mappin 1447 56.5 26.8, Lieutenant Suncrest around /mappin 1447 66.0 29.0, and Ranger Lydrea patrolling around /mappin 1447 69.0 30.0. These pins are search areas; verify every member has the named-target quest items before leaving.

steps.title: Unlock Rimtori's confrontation
steps.note: Return to the tome and read the next objective before activating the encounter.

steps.title: Defeat Magus Rimtori
steps.note: Break the seals as instructed, defeat Rimtori and make sure everyone obtains her head. Check the tome before leaving. If it already offers {quest:91538}, take that delivery manually now; otherwise the later catch-up returns after {npc:8576}'s reward.

steps.title: Report Rimtori's defeat at Valormok
steps.note: {npc:8576} receives Rimtori's head and sends you to Belgrom in {zone:1454}. Hand the tablets to {npc:8587} and the beach fragments to {npc:247473} while at the same hub.

steps.title: Take {npc:8587}'s four deliveries
steps.note: Take all four after {quest:3517}. Xylem is local; the three capital deliveries are routed across the next chapters.

steps.title: Catch the tome delivery if needed
steps.note: Return to the tome after handing {quest:91500} to {npc:8576} if you could not take it earlier. This is a required prerequisite for the later {quest:91548} group objective.

steps.title: Report the Legashi kills
steps.note: Return to {npc:235903} in the Ruins of Eldarath. This closes the northern kill quest before leaving {zone:1447}.

steps.title: Deliver the summoning tome to {npc:8587}
steps.note: Deliver the tome to {npc:8587} at Valormok.

steps.title: Take the tome onward to {npc:3326}
steps.note: At Valormok, {npc:8587} sends the tome onward to {npc:3326} in {zone:1454}.

steps.title: Visit {npc:8379}
steps.note: Reach Xylem's tower using Sanath Lim-yo's teleport service at the base of the mountain, then speak with Xylem above. Keep the other capital deliveries.

steps.title: Close the local tablet delivery
steps.note: Return to {npc:8587} at Valormok, then travel to {zone:1454}. The other three payment receipts will be delivered together in chapter 9.

goals.text: A {item:249698} may begin A Lost Memento if acquired incidentally. Reports suggest Neutral Timbermaw is needed. Do not divert to grind reputation or camp furbolgs for it.

steps.title: Report to Belgrom
steps.note: Belgrom Rockmaul is in {zone:1454}'s Valley of Honor. This is the final reward for the blood-elf revenge chain.

steps.title: Deliver {npc:8659}'s tablet
steps.note: Find {npc:8659} above the Alchemy shop in the Drag. Keep the payment quest for chapter 9.

steps.title: Let {npc:3326} examine the tome
steps.note: {npc:3326} is in the Cleft of Shadow. Keep {quest:91548} for the chapter 5 {zone:1419} group visit; its {zone:1454} reward is scheduled in chapter 8.

steps.title: Begin the Alcaz rescue chain
steps.note: Speak with Eitrigg in Grommash Hold, Valley of Wisdom. The next chapter starts by reporting to Nazeer Bloodpike at Brackenwall Village.

steps.title: Chapter hand-off
steps.note: Keep {quest:95283}, {quest:91548}, {quest:3542}, {quest:3518} and {quest:3563}. Also preserve any {item:12402} or Sunken Temple preparation from the previous pack. Continue immediately; the displayed level range is an estimate, not a grinding gate.

goals.text: Confirm the party has the five carry quests

names.quest:96335: The Man in the Iron Chains

steps.title: Report to Brackenwall Village
steps.note: Nazeer Bloodpike is at Brackenwall Village: /mappin 1445 35.2 30.7. Bring the introduction accepted from Eitrigg in chapter 1.

steps.title: Reach Ulka on Alcaz Island
steps.note: Travel to Alcaz Island in northeast {zone:1445}. Ulka is outside the prison: /mappin 1445 70.3 18.9. This is a Dustwallow map pin, not an instance coordinate.

steps.title: Hear Ulka's situation
steps.note: Speak with Ulka and select the conversation about the prisoners. Every player must receive the quest credit.

steps.title: Take both core prison assignments
steps.note: These share the same clear. {quest:96332} needs 15 Strashaz Soldiers, 8 Strashaz Enchantresses and Ca'zass's Head; check all five logs before entering.

goals.text: Blood Red Bandanas is optional incidental loot only. Its collection rate is not verified at 80% or better for a five-player party, so no extra clear or waiting is budgeted. The Dragon's Journal is Alliance-only.

steps.title: Agree on the single-clear order
steps.note: Do not kill The Questioner on the first pass. Reach the final prisoner, have every player accept {quest:96335} from Mason Connery, then backtrack for The Questioner's key. Killing him early can spoil the one-clear plan.

goals.text: All five players understand: leave The Questioner alive

steps.title: Enter Alcaz Prison
steps.note: Clear the required path while keeping the group in credit range. Count Soldiers and Enchantresses for {quest:96332}. Leave The Questioner alive even if he is available as an optional boss.

goals.text: Enter Alcaz Prison together

steps.title: Locate Commander Folkar
steps.note: Find Commander Folkar inside the prison. Do not leave his area before taking his next quest.

steps.title: Continue Folkar's investigation
steps.note: Hand in to Commander Folkar inside Alcaz Prison and take {quest:95454} before continuing toward the final prisoner.

steps.title: Finish the main prison route
steps.note: Finish the required bosses, investigate the final prisoner and loot Ca'zass's Head. Confirm the 15 Soldier and 8 Enchantress credits and the head for every eligible player before moving to the final room's quest interactions.

steps.title: Read the Perfumed Note
steps.note: Use the Perfumed Note near the final boss. This note is the turn-in and follow-up source; the next hand-in is back at Commander Folkar.

steps.title: Ask Mason Connery about the chains
steps.note: Speak with Mason Connery near the end of the prison after finishing the main encounter. Everyone takes his quest before anyone pulls The Questioner.

goals.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

steps.title: Confirm the key quest before the pull
steps.note: Check the actual quest in each log. This readiness check is deliberate: the key is obtained on the return trip, and the guide aims to finish everything in this one instance clear.

goals.text: All five players have {quest:96335}

steps.title: Return for The Questioner's key
steps.note: Backtrack to The Questioner, kill him now and have every player loot the required key. Return to Mason after the five quest logs show completion.

goals.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

steps.title: Free Mason and follow his lead
steps.note: Mason Connery supplies the lead to Moonbrook in {zone:1436}. Keep his note and the follow-up quest for the {zone:1415} trip below.

goals.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

steps.title: Give Folkar the bad news
steps.note: Visit Commander Folkar before leaving the instance. Hold {quest:95483} for the chapter 8 {zone:1454} reward circuit.

steps.title: Finish with Ulka outside
steps.note: Return to Ulka on Alcaz Island. Verify Mason's follow-up and Thrall's report are in your log before leaving Dustwallow.

steps.title: Catch the {item:12402} introduction if missing
steps.note: Before crossing to the {zone:1415}, visit {npc:8579} at Steamwheedle Port in {zone:1446} if this quest was not taken after the previous pack's Zul'Farrak hand-ins. {quest:3527} must already be turned in. Do not reach Jintha'Alor without the egg quest.

steps.title: Cross to the {zone:1415}
steps.note: From Dustwallow, or {zone:1446} if you needed the catch-up, travel to Ratchet and use the Booty Bay boat. Keep the Document Box when you obtain it; it has a vendor value but is required for {quest:96379}.

goals.text: Take the Ratchet boat to Booty Bay

steps.title: Reach Moonbrook's upstairs inn
steps.note: Travel north through Stranglethorn and {zone:1431} into {zone:1436}. At /mappin 1436 43.4 67.8, search upstairs in the Moonbrook inn. Follow Mason's Note to the Loose Floorboards and Connery's Trunk; each player keeps the Document Box. This is an object hand-in, not an NPC in town.

steps.title: Give the Document Box to Rix
steps.note: Return to Rix Xizzix in Booty Bay: /mappin 1434 28.5 75.8. Use this turn-in for the route. Nazgrel's {zone:1454} version is an alternative for the same box; its reward is not additional XP.

steps.title: Take Jammal'an's quest in the {zone:1425}
steps.note: Travel to the {npc:5598} at Shadra'Alor: /mappin 1425 33.8 75.2. Hold this for Sunken Temple in chapter 5. It does not require Pool of Tears.

steps.title: Climb Jintha'Alor for the {item:12402}
steps.note: Follow the ramps to Jintha'Alor's upper terrace, then enter the cave behind the altar. The egg's recorded location is /mappin 1425 57.5 86.8. Clear together and let every player interact; keep the egg for {npc:8579} in chapter 3.

steps.title: Deliver {npc:6522}'s tablet in {zone:1458}
steps.note: Travel to {zone:1458} and find {npc:6522} in the Apothecarium. Keep his payment for Jediga in chapter 9. The next chapter starts in {zone:1456}; use the {zone:1454} zeppelin connection and your known flight paths.

steps.title: Check the dungeon hand-off
steps.note: Keep {quest:95483}, {quest:1446}, Vek'zol, {npc:8659}'s Payment to Jediga and {quest:3564}. Delivery to {npc:4046} is still due in chapter 3. {quest:4787} should be complete, ready for the {zone:1446} hand-in. Continue without a grinding gate.

steps.title: Deliver {npc:4046}'s tablet
steps.note: Begin in {zone:1456}. {npc:4046} is on Elder Rise. Keep her payment with the {npc:8659} and Andron receipts for the chapter 9 {zone:1447} return.

steps.title: Follow the Uldaman discovery
steps.note: Speak with {npc:3978} in {zone:1456}. This continues {quest:2440} from the previous pack's Uldaman circuit; that prerequisite must already be handed in. Keep the Discs of Uldum for the {zone:1446} visit.

steps.title: Ask {npc:5770} about Uldum
steps.note: {npc:5770} is on Elder Rise. This sets up the southern {zone:1446} pedestal and Stone Watcher dialogue.

steps.title: Catch the Sunken Temple introduction
steps.note: If missed in the previous guide, stop at {npc:8115} in Camp Mojache, {zone:1444}, before visiting {npc:7771}. This introduction unlocks {quest:3444} and the two required Temple quests.

steps.title: Take the Gadgetzan kill quests
steps.note: {npc:11758} and {npc:7876} are in Gadgetzan. Both quests use shared kill credit; they fit the west and southwest {zone:1446} circuit after the dungeon preparation.

steps.title: Meet {npc:7771}
steps.note: {npc:7771} is at the Broken Pillar: /mappin 1446 52.7 45.9.

steps.title: Take {npc:7771}'s {item:10556} assignment
steps.note: Take {quest:3444} at the Broken Pillar before travelling to Ratchet; the chest is a prerequisite collection, not a separate dungeon run.

steps.title: Retrieve {npc:7771}'s {item:10556}
steps.note: Travel to Ratchet and open {npc:7771}'s chest: /mappin 1413 62.5 38.5. Every player needs the {item:10556}. Return to {zone:1446} afterward; this preparation can also be done during downtime once the quest is accepted.

steps.title: Bring the {item:12402} to {npc:8579}
steps.note: Visit {npc:8579} at Steamwheedle Port with the egg collected in Jintha'Alor. Keep the supplied egg and {quest:3528} for chapter 5's Temple clear; its final reward is collected in chapter 8.

steps.title: Finish the Temple preparation at {npc:7771}
steps.note: Return the {item:10556} at the Broken Pillar. Keep both new quests for Sunken Temple. Together with Jammal'an and {quest:3528}, these must be in every player's log before the later dungeon clear.

steps.title: Clear the Dunemaul Compound
steps.note: At the Dunemaul Compound, kill 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers and {npc:12046}. Work through the required ogres together.

goals.text: If Dunemaul Dues is available and its single bangle drops during these kills, it is an optional overlap. Do not turn this into a separate personal-drop farm.

steps.title: Finish {quest:3362}
steps.note: In southwest {zone:1446}, kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers. Both are shared kill objectives.

steps.title: Use the southern Uldum pedestal
steps.note: Continue to the sealed Uldum entrance in southern {zone:1446} and use the {object:142343} with your Discs. Speak with the {npc:7918} who appears. This is an outdoor dialogue visit, not Uldaman.

steps.title: Listen to the Stone Watcher
steps.note: Each player talks through the Stone Watcher's dialogue until the quest registers completion. Stay until all five have credit.

steps.title: Keep the {zone:1456} report
steps.note: Use the pedestal again to finish and take the return quest. Hold {quest:2967} for the chapter 8 capital circuit.

steps.title: Close the {zone:1446} kill quests
steps.note: Return to {npc:11758} and {npc:7876} in Gadgetzan, then travel southwest to the pass into {zone:1449}. Sell and repair before beginning the crater circuit.

steps.title: Meet {npc:9619}
steps.note: {npc:9619} stands near the southeastern entrance from {zone:1446}. Take these together. {quest:87492} requires level 50; the {zone:1446} rewards normally put the lowest starting member beyond that threshold.

goals.text: While moving through the crater, gather seven each of the red, yellow, blue and green power crystals from the ground. They prepare {npc:9117}'s pylon quests. Keep any {item:280459} or {item:11116} that drops naturally; neither is a required farm.

steps.title: Find the carcass and damaged crystal
steps.note: For the meat, inspect the fresh carcass around /mappin 1449 68.6 57.3. The Damaged Blue Crystal is a separate ground pickup around /mappin 1449 66.3 75.2. Each player interacts with both objectives.

steps.title: Return the first {npc:9619} finds
steps.note: Return to {npc:9619} at the entrance. He provides the next step toward summoning Lar'korwi.

steps.title: Collect the scent from nest guards
steps.note: Walk onto ravasaur nests in southeastern Un'Goro to draw Lar'korwi Mates. Each player needs two Ravasaur Pheromone Glands. This is a deliberate collection exception to unlock the named elite: the reported rate is near 78%, not a guaranteed or 80%-plus drop. Rotate nests around /mappin 1449 66.8 73.1 and /mappin 1449 66.5 67.1.

goals.text: {item:280459} (item 280459) can start Microcrystal Contamination from ordinary ravasaurs. Accept only if it drops naturally and hand it to {npc:9619} on the next return; no extra farm is included.

steps.title: Prepare Lar'korwi's bait
steps.note: Return to {npc:9619} and take his prepared bait. Coordinate the summon so everyone has the quest and is close enough to participate.

steps.title: Summon and defeat Lar'korwi
steps.note: Use {npc:9619}'s supplies at the eastern feeding site around /mappin 1449 79.5 49.9. Follow the item instructions in order, kill Lar'korwi and check that everyone loots the quest trophy.

steps.title: Finish the Lar'korwi hunt
steps.note: Return to {npc:9619}. Keep {quest:4289} for the northern cave visit after loading the Marshal's Refuge quests.

steps.title: Inspect the wrecked raft
steps.note: Inspect {object:161505} at the southeastern lake, close to /mappin 1449 63.1 69.1. Then look in the water beside it for {object:161504}.

steps.title: Recover the small pack
steps.note: Each player interacts with {object:161504} near the raft. Open the provided pack in your bags and remove all three quest items before taking them to {npc:8737} at Marshal's Refuge.

steps.title: Deliver the pack and load the Refuge quests
steps.note: Travel to Marshal's Refuge in the north. Visit {npc:8737}, {npc:9270}, {npc:9272}, {npc:9271} and {npc:9118}. {quest:3882} is optional because plentiful ground spawns have not been verified for live Forever. Stop {npc:8737}'s chain here; the long continuation is outside this route. Keep {npc:9271}'s Scraping Vial.

goals.text: If {item:11116} (item 11116) dropped during normal travel, it begins {npc:9270}'s Journal for an incidental hand-in at this hub.

steps.title: Read the Pterrordax warning
steps.note: Read the {quest:4501} warning at Marshal's Refuge. {npc:9997} receives the reward after 10 Pterrordax and 15 {npc:9167} kills.

steps.title: Meet {npc:9117} in the cave
steps.note: Find {npc:9117} inside the Marshal's Refuge cave. The first crystal collection must be handed in before the three pylon quests appear.

steps.title: Finish the ground-crystal set
steps.note: Each player needs seven of each color: red, yellow, blue and green. Use the crystals gathered on the incoming ride and collect missing colors from nearby ground clusters. These are pickups, not mob drops.

steps.title: Unlock the three pylon surveys
steps.note: Take all three from {npc:9117} before leaving the cave. Inspecting a pylon before its quest is accepted does not replace the quest credit.

steps.title: Work the shared kills around the crater
steps.note: During the circuit, kill five each of Bloodpetal Lashers, Trappers, Flayers and Threshers, plus 10 Pterrordax and 15 {npc:9167}. The pins mark northern starting areas; the four plants and two pterrordax types are spread around the crater. Finish missing types before turn-in.

steps.title: Survey the northern pylon
steps.note: Inspect the {object:164955} on the northern rim. Every player must receive credit, then continue east toward Fungal Rock.

steps.title: Collect the ape pelts at Fungal Rock
steps.note: In and around the northeastern gorilla cave, collect two Gorilla, two Stomper and two Thunderer pelts per player. This is the route's explicit low-rate collection exception because it unlocks the named U'cha hunt. Do not kill U'cha for this follow-up before everyone has accepted it from {npc:9619}.

steps.title: Survey the eastern pylon and recover supplies
steps.note: Inspect the {object:164957}. On the same side of the crater, recover the {quest:3881} supplies at /mappin 1449 68.5 36.5. The second crate is on the western half of the circuit, so the whole quest is not complete yet.

goals.text: Each player collects the eastern {quest:3881} crate

steps.title: Unlock the U'cha hunt at {npc:9619}
steps.note: Return south to {npc:9619}, hand in the three pelt types and take {quest:4301}. The next loop goes through the southern hive and western crater, then returns to the northern cave.

steps.title: Take the hive wall sample
steps.note: Enter the southern Slithering Scar hive. Find the chamber with hanging larvae around /mappin 1449 48.6 85.2 and use the Scraping Vial to obtain the {item:11131}. Forever's objective is the wall sample, not the older Soil Sample; ignore a quest tracker that sends you to {zone:1446}.

steps.title: Check incidental ground bones in Terror Run

goals.text: If ground bones are visible around /mappin 1449 31.0 78.0, pick them up while finishing nearby pterrordax. {quest:3882} needs eight per player, but the old ground-location reports do not establish current Forever respawn times. Do not wait, camp the pickups or farm personal dinosaur drops; unfinished bones do not hold this route.

steps.title: Retrieve the western expedition equipment
steps.note: Recover the second expedition crate at /mappin 1449 38.5 66.0. Every player should now have both the eastern supplies and western equipment.

steps.title: Survey the western pylon
steps.note: Inspect the {object:164956} on the western rim before heading north. The three survey quests will all be handed in together to {npc:9117}.

steps.title: Finish the remaining crater kill counts
steps.note: Finish only the missing Bloodpetal types and the two pterrordax counts from the log. The pins mark western and northern finishing areas, not every variant. This completes the accepted shared kill quests; there is no additional XP-grinding target.

steps.title: Return to Fungal Rock for U'cha
steps.note: Enter Fungal Rock again with the follow-up accepted. U'cha is the large red gorilla deeper inside, around /mappin 1449 68.5 12.6. Check the quest pelt for every player before leaving.

steps.title: Collect the Marshal's Refuge rewards
steps.note: At Marshal's Refuge, visit {npc:9270}, {npc:9272}, {npc:9271}, {npc:9118} and {npc:9997}. Keep the chapter 5 dungeon quests and the capital receipts in your log.
steps.label: refuge-rewards

steps.title: Hand in incidental Dinosaur Bones if ready
steps.note: Hand the eight bones to {npc:9272} only if the optional quest finished naturally. This reward is outside the chapter's baseline XP.

steps.title: Give Collie all three pylon surveys
steps.note: Return inside the Refuge cave to {npc:9117}. Take {quest:4321} after the surveys are handed in.

steps.title: Finish Collie's research conversation
steps.note: Speak with Collie as requested to finish her research. No repeatable crystal collection is required.

steps.title: Bring U'cha's pelt to {npc:9619}
steps.note: Make the final return to {npc:9619} at the southeastern entrance. This reward closes the ape-chain exception. Use your best available flight or hearth connection for the next chapter's {zone:1448} entry.

goals.text: An available escort such as Ringo or A-Me can be considered during downtime, but this route does not wait for a spawn. A-Me's chain also needs a Mithril Casing. Finding the Source is reserved for the later {zone:1414} return, when the whole group meets its level requirement.

steps.title: Confirm the Temple preparations
steps.note: Retain {quest:3446}, {quest:3447}, {quest:3528} and Jammal'an the Prophet for chapter 5. Keep Vek'zol, Thrall Needs to Know, {quest:2967} and all three Jediga payment receipts. Proceed to {zone:1448}; no grinding is required to match this chapter's estimated level label.

goals.text: Keep all four Sunken Temple quests and the delayed rewards

steps.title: Emerald Sanctuary assignments
steps.note: Travel to southern {zone:1448} and meet {npc:10922} and {npc:10921} at Emerald Sanctuary. The displayed range describes the route, not a requirement to grind before continuing. Keep the Temple quests and receipts carried from earlier chapters.

goals.text: Keep several of the 40 quest slots free for this chapter's short chains. Turn completed local quests in at the listed stops.

steps.title: {npc:11554} at the southern road
steps.note: Speak with {npc:11554} just south of Emerald Sanctuary. Pick up the Deadwood quest now; the group will kill Overlord Ror on the same later southern circuit after collecting {npc:9620}'s quest.

steps.title: First Jaedenar clear
steps.note: Head northwest into Jaedenar. Kill the four types named in the quest log together; remain in credit range of the party. This first surface clear unlocks the water chain.

goals.text: If a {item:13140} drops naturally, keep it. Arko'narin's optional rescue is checked on the later Shadow Hold visit; do not farm the key.

steps.title: Bloodvenom Post pickups
steps.note: Continue north to Bloodvenom Post. {npc:9620} is here, not at Emerald Sanctuary. Collect her Ror assignment before the southern Deadwood clear. {npc:9996} starts the moonwell chain.

steps.title: Irontree corruption
steps.note: Continue northeast into Irontree Woods. Kill the Entropic Beasts and Entropic Horrors required by {npc:10921}, and enter the area to satisfy the investigation objective. Only the two specified elemental types count.

steps.title: Submerged statue starter
steps.note: Check the submerged {object:661778} in the water near Irontree Woods. Each player should interact with the statue to begin the new Forever quest and carry its bauble back to {npc:9996}.

steps.title: Deliver the bauble at Bloodvenom
steps.note: Return southwest to {npc:9996} at Bloodvenom Post. This is a fixed quest interaction, not a rare-spawn camp.

steps.title: Sample the corrupt moonwell
steps.note: Travel south to the corrupted moonwell in the Ruins of Constellas. Each player uses {npc:9996}'s supplied flask at the well and confirms the sample in their own quest log.

steps.title: Report the first corruption sweep
steps.note: Return southeast to Emerald Sanctuary. Speak with {npc:10922} and {npc:10921}, then take {npc:10922}'s follow-up before returning to Jaedenar.

steps.title: Southern Deadwood and Overlord Ror
steps.note: Go south to Deadwood Village. Complete {npc:11554}'s three kill counts and kill Overlord Ror at the back of the village. Everyone must loot their own Ror's Claw before leaving; one party member's item does not finish the other players' quests.

goals.text: If a {item:20741} drops, keep it only if useful to your reputation plan. Its Neutral requirement is not a reason to grind reputation for this guide.

steps.title: {npc:11554}'s northern introduction
steps.note: Return to {npc:11554} beside the southern road. Carry the introduction to {npc:15395} for the final northbound pass through {zone:1448}.

steps.title: Jaedenar water sample
steps.note: Return to the moonwell inside Jaedenar. This is a different sample from {npc:9996}'s Constellas moonwell. Every player uses {npc:10922}'s supplied container at this well.

steps.title: {npc:10922}'s spiritual-aid request
steps.note: Return to {npc:10922} at Emerald Sanctuary. The next delivery is to {npc:5901} on the {zone:1413} coast south of Ratchet. It must be completed before the Shadow Hold flame quest becomes available.

steps.title: Bless the water on the Ratchet coast
steps.note: Travel to Ratchet, then south along the {zone:1413} coast to {npc:5901}. Hand over the corrupt water and take the cleansed-water return quest. Use available flight paths and hearthstones to shorten this required out-and-back trip.

steps.title: Bring the cleansed water to {npc:10922}
steps.note: Return to Emerald Sanctuary in {zone:1448}. Speak with {npc:10922} and take {quest:5165} before entering Shadow Hold.

steps.title: Shadow Hold's four flames
steps.note: Enter Shadow Hold beneath Jaedenar and use the quest item on all four named protective flames. Keep the five-person group together and check all four objectives for every player before leaving the cave.

goals.text: Optional: if you found the {item:13140}, it starts A Strange Red Key (#5202). Check Captured Arko'narin while already inside. Continue Rescue From Jaedenar (#5203) only if the escort is available immediately and the whole party wants it; do not wait for a reset. The later optional rewards are outside the core XP budget.

steps.title: Bloodvenom rewards and the cat carrier
steps.note: Head north to Bloodvenom Post. Give Ror's Claw to {npc:9620} and the corrupt sample to {npc:9996}, then accept {npc:9996}'s cat experiment.

steps.title: Lead the corrupted cat home
steps.note: Return to the Constellas moonwell south of Jaedenar and use the supplied cat carrier. Escort the resulting corrupted saber back to {npc:9996} at Bloodvenom Post. At {npc:9996}, interact with your following cat and release it; simply arriving without the final interaction may not complete the quest. Each player checks their own completion.

steps.title: Finish {npc:9996}'s experiment
steps.note: Speak with {npc:9996} at Bloodvenom Post after your cat has been released beside her.

steps.title: Report the flames and hold the finale
steps.note: Return to {npc:10922} at Emerald Sanctuary. Accept {quest:5242} now and keep it for chapter 9, when the group returns stronger. That quest targets Shadow Lord Fel'dan, {npc:9861} and {npc:9860}; this visit stops after accepting it.

steps.title: {npc:15395} at the northern tunnel
steps.note: Travel north along {zone:1448}'s main road to {npc:15395} outside Timbermaw Hold. Hand over {npc:11554}'s introduction and take the northern Deadwood assignment.

steps.title: Northern Deadwood camp
steps.note: Clear the hostile Deadwood camp west of {npc:15395}. Complete the three specified kill counts together. Leave friendly Timbermaw furbolgs alone; the route does not require a reputation farm.

steps.title: {npc:15395}'s {zone:1452} introduction
steps.note: Return to {npc:15395}. Take {quest:8465} for the short trip through Timbermaw Hold toward {zone:1452}.

steps.title: {npc:11556} outside the eastern tunnel exit
steps.note: Pass through Timbermaw Hold to its {zone:1452} exit and speak with {npc:11556}. Avoid attacking the Timbermaw. This introduction is the end of the northern {zone:1448} pass; the full {zone:1452} circuit belongs to chapter 9.

steps.title: {zone:1454} transit and Plaguelands call
steps.note: Travel to {zone:1454} before crossing to {zone:1415}. At level 50 or above, take {npc:10880}'s Plaguelands call near the Valley of Strength. Keep it for the Bulwark in chapter 6, along with {quest:5242} and the previously prepared Temple quests.

goals.title: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

goals.text: Continue to the {zone:1419} and Sunken Temple chapter. There is no grind checkpoint at this chapter boundary.

written.Interact with the {object:141980} reveal: Interact with the Spectral Lockbox revealed beside the Fallen Hero and Corporal. Each player must finish their own reward dialogue.

steps.title: Meet the Fallen Hero
steps.note: Cross to {zone:1415} and travel through Stonard to the {npc:7572} at the {zone:1435} / {zone:1419} boundary. Start his Horde introduction. Keep {quest:91548}, the four prepared Temple quests, and A Call to Arms in your log.

steps.title: Hear the Fallen Hero's account
steps.note: Continue the Fallen Hero's dialogue until {quest:2784} is ready to finish, then accept {quest:2621}.

steps.title: {npc:7623} in Stonard
steps.note: Return north to Stonard. {npc:7623} sends the group to {npc:7643} in the same settlement.

steps.title: {npc:7643}'s stolen orders
steps.note: Speak with {npc:7643} at Stonard and take the assignment to recover the {item:8463} from the Swamp Talker.

steps.title: Kill the Swamp Talker
steps.note: Head east to Stagalbog, the murloc cave between Stonard and the coastal orc camp. The pin marks the cave approach. Search the interior for the Swamp Talker; he has reported positions near the entrance and deeper in the cave, including a raised platform reached by the ramp. Kill him together, then have every player loot their own {item:8463}.

steps.title: Return the orders to the Fallen Hero
steps.note: Return to the Fallen Hero at the northern {zone:1419} boundary. Start {quest:2801} and listen through his account.

steps.title: The binding-stone assignment
steps.note: Complete the Fallen Hero's dialogue, collect the reward, and accept {quest:2681}. Its four servant types are spread around the zone, so keep the entire group on this stage before moving out.

steps.title: Western servants and the {quest:91548} summon
steps.note: Begin the binding-stone circuit at Dreadmaul Hold in the northwest for Servants of Grol, then work south toward the Altar of Storms for Servants of Sevine. Fight each servant beside its own binding stone; when it becomes vulnerable, interact with the stone to release it. At the Altar of Storms use the carried {npc:247449}, defeat {quest:91548}, and have everyone loot the Heart of Vek'zol.

goals.text: Keep the completed {quest:91548} quest and heart for Zevrost in chapter 8. This chapter counts the fight, not its later quest reward.

Opportunistic new starter: if a Dreadmaul Brute drops a Carved Stone Trinket, it begins Memories of Rockard (#87451), delivered to {npc:7623} in Stonard. Take it if it drops on this circuit; do not farm extra brutes for it.

If a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere drops naturally, check Kum'isha the Collector for the conditional new chain leading to To Serve the Draenei (#93572, prerequisite #93685). Only continue if the dialogue is offered; no sphere farm or rare-spawn camp is included.

steps.title: Finish the binding-stone circuit
steps.note: Continue to the Servants of Razelikh around the Dark Portal and the Servants of Allistarj along the eastern side near Serpent's Coil. Finish any missing Grol or Sevine targets on the northbound return. The complete quest requires 9 Razelikh, 3 Grol, 3 Allistarj and 3 Sevine servants. Weaken each beside its binding stone and use that stone; ordinary damage alone does not finish the release.

steps.title: The Fallen Hero summons his comrade
steps.note: Return to the Fallen Hero. After turning in the servant quest, accept {quest:2702} and speak through the summoning dialogue so {npc:7750} appears nearby.

steps.title: {npc:7750}
steps.note: Speak with the summoned {npc:7750} beside the Fallen Hero. His follow-up has the same title but a different quest number and ends at the {object:141980}.

steps.title: Open the {object:141980}
steps.note: Interact with the {object:141980} revealed beside the Fallen Hero and {npc:7750}. Each player must finish their own reward dialogue.

steps.title: Take {quest:2721}'s assignment
steps.note: Speak with the Fallen Hero again and accept {quest:2721}. Travel to Serpent's Coil on the eastern side of the {zone:1419}.

steps.title: Defeat {quest:2721} and speak to his spirit
steps.note: Fight through Serpent's Coil to {quest:2721} the Damned and defeat him together. His released {npc:7729} is the quest turn-in, not the Fallen Hero. All five should speak with the spirit and take {quest:2743} before leaving.

steps.title: Close this part of the Fallen Hero story
steps.note: Return to the Fallen Hero and finish {quest:2743}. This route stops this chain here; the following world-boss preparation is outside the five-level package.

steps.title: Five-player Temple preparation check
steps.note: Regroup in {zone:1435} before entering the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Every player needs {quest:3446} (#3446), {quest:3447} (#3447), {quest:1446} (#1446), and {quest:3528} (#3528). Each player also needs their own supplied Egg of Hakkar. The earlier chapters collect these prerequisites; resolve any missing quest before the clear.

goals.text: All five have the four Temple quests and their own Egg of Hakkar
Reserve one free quest slot and bag space for the {item:10454} item-started quest inside. The quest-log limit is 40.
Personal class quests and an already-prepared The Temple of Atal'Hakkar (#1445) can be completed on this clear. They are additional rewards, not universal group XP in this package.

steps.title: The lower altar
steps.note: Enter the Sunken Temple through the temple in the Pool of Tears. From the instance entrance, take the lower route to the bottom pit and clear access to the {object:148836}. Every player interacts with the altar and turns in {quest:3446} before the group moves on.

steps.title: Solve the lower serpent-statue circle
steps.note: Clear the lower balconies and the pit. Activate the six serpent statues in compass order: south, north, southwest, southeast, northwest, northeast. Defeat Atal'alarion, then each player clicks the large {object:148838} in the pit to claim {quest:3447}. These are the lower puzzle statues, not the upper troll-boss platforms.

steps.title: Upper troll platforms and Jammal'an
steps.note: Clear the upper troll platforms needed to open the prophet's area, then defeat {quest:1446}. Every player loots their own {item:6212}. Keep the quest for the {npc:5598} in the {zone:1425} after the dungeon.

steps.title: The Hakkar event
steps.note: Clear the Sanctum of the Fallen God and start the event with the supplied egg. Kill the bloodkeepers, use their blood on the flames, and interrupt/kill suppressors. After defeating the Avatar, every player loots and uses the Essence of Hakkar to fill their own egg, then checks the quest as complete. Keep the completed quest for {npc:8579} in chapter 8.

goals.text: Forever players report a failed summon after the fourth blood. One reported workaround is to kill all remaining spawned mobs before using the final blood on the fourth flame. Treat this as a player report, not a guaranteed fix.

steps.title: Eranikus and the quest-starting essence
steps.note: Complete the dragon-wing clear and defeat the Shade of Eranikus. Every player loots the {item:10454}, opens that item in their own bags, and accepts its quest before leaving the chamber.

steps.title: Finish the essence hand-in
steps.note: Interact with the {object:148512} in Eranikus's chamber and finish the item-started quest now. Do not leave the dungeon carrying this unfinished reward.

goals.text: The optional follow-up {item:10454} (#3374) gives up the Chained Essence of Eranikus trinket. It is not an automatic group step in this package.

steps.title: Check the one-clear objectives
steps.note: Before exiting, compare quest logs: {quest:3446} and {quest:3447} are turned in, everyone has Jammal'an's head and a filled Hakkar egg, and everyone has used the Eranikus Essence Font. Finish any missed interaction while the group is still inside.

goals.text: All five confirm the Temple objectives and in-instance rewards

steps.title: {zone:1425} prophet reward
steps.note: Travel north to the {zone:1425} and visit the {npc:5598} at Shadra'Alor. Turn in Jammal'an here before continuing toward the Bulwark. Keep the filled Hakkar egg and {quest:91548}'s heart for the later {zone:1414} delivery chapter.

goals.text: Continue to {zone:1422}. This chapter's 51-51 label is an estimated range; it does not require an extra grinding session.

written.Kill the eight Diseased Wolves required: Kill the eight Diseased Wolves required by Mulgris in the central countryside north and west of Writhing Haunt. Stay within shared kill-credit range; this quest needs no personal item drops.

written.Return to {npc:10778} upstairs in the Fe: Return to Janice upstairs in the Felstone house and collect the final reward before moving east.

steps.title: Report to the Bulwark
steps.note: Travel to the Bulwark on the Tirisfal / {zone:1422} boundary. Turn {npc:10880}'s carried call in to {npc:10837}, and take {quest:5096}. Speak with {npc:10839} for the commission.

goals.title: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

steps.title: Commission and the fire bottle
steps.note: Finish Garush's commission dialogue. Before leaving, every player collects a {item:12814} from the container beside Derrington, and checks for the supplied Scourge Banner. Equip the commission if you want Argent Dawn scourgestone drops during the route.

steps.title: Burn the Scarlet command tent
steps.note: Head east to the Scarlet camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears. Clear the camp, then use the bottle to burn the command tent and plant the Scourge Banner. Each player checks their own completion; do the interaction for everyone rather than assuming the first player's banner credits all five.

steps.title: Derrington opens the cauldron chain
steps.note: Return to Derrington at the Bulwark. Take both the cauldron introduction and the watchtower assignment. Keep the Beacon Torch for the later Andorhal crossing.

steps.title: Vandis and Felstone Field
steps.note: Walk to {npc:11055} at the southern side of the Bulwark camp. She gives the Horde cauldron targets in sequence. Each farm must be reported back before the next target unlocks.

steps.title: Felstone's cauldron keeper
steps.note: Go east to Felstone Field and defeat Cauldron Lord Bilemaw. Every player loots a key for their own quest before interacting with the cauldron.

steps.title: Felstone cauldron interaction
steps.note: Each player opens the {object:176361} at Felstone Field, completes the target quest and accepts {quest:5230}. The return comes from the cauldron itself, not from Vandis.

steps.title: {npc:10778} upstairs at Felstone
steps.note: Before leaving the farm, clear the house and speak with {npc:10778} upstairs. She sends you to her parcel in the nearby barn.

steps.title: {npc:10778}'s parcel in the barn
steps.note: Click {item:12724} in the Felstone barn. Finish the first quest and accept its same-name delivery follow-up for {npc:10781} in {zone:1458}.

steps.title: First Bulwark return
steps.note: Return west to Vandis and unlock Dalson's Tears before the {zone:1458} errand. Do not accept repeatable cauldron reagent collection quests; this route counts the four first-time farm clears.

steps.title: {zone:1458} parcel delivery
steps.note: Continue west into {zone:1458} and find {npc:10781} in the central city. Hand over {npc:10778}'s parcel and take his message to {npc:8403} nearby.

steps.title: {npc:8403}'s half-charm
steps.note: Speak with {npc:8403} in central {zone:1458}. Take {quest:5050} back to {npc:10778}. Keep the half-charm in your bags for the final assembly.

steps.title: Bring the charm to {npc:10778}
steps.note: Return through the Bulwark to {npc:10778} upstairs in the Felstone house. Take {quest:5051} before killing the Jabbering Ghoul for its half of the charm.

steps.title: The Jabbering Ghoul's half
steps.note: Find the named Jabbering Ghoul roaming Felstone Field near the barn and cauldron. Kill it together, have everyone loot their own other half, and use the halves to assemble the {item:12723}. It is a named quest target, not a rare-loot camp.

steps.title: Finish {npc:10778}'s story
steps.note: Return to {npc:10778} upstairs in the Felstone house and collect the final reward before moving east.

steps.title: Dalson's cauldron keeper
steps.note: Travel east to Dalson's Tears and defeat Cauldron Lord Malvinious. Every player loots their own cauldron key.

steps.title: Dalson's cauldron interaction
steps.note: Open the {object:177289} at Dalson's Tears and take the next {quest:5232}. Stay at this farm briefly for the diary and cabinet chain.

steps.title: Read {quest:5058}
steps.note: At level 52 or above, enter the Dalson's Tears barn and read the diary on the floor. Click its Complete dialogue. This is an immediate object quest and does not need a separate quest-log acceptance.

steps.title: The Wandering Skeleton's key
steps.note: Find the named Wandering Skeleton around the Dalson's Tears barn and house and kill it together. One party member needs the {item:12738} to open the next encounter; do not wait for five separate outhouse keys.

goals.text: Confirm one party member has a {item:12738}

steps.title: Open the outhouse and defeat Farmer Dalson
steps.note: Use an outhouse key at the Outhouse behind the barn and house. One player opens it to release Farmer Dalson; defeat him together and have every player loot the {item:12739}. The zero-XP repeatable opening is optional on individual trackers because the party needs the summon, not five separate summons.

steps.title: The upstairs cabinet reward
steps.note: Enter the Dalson house beside the barn and go upstairs. Each player uses their cabinet key at the {object:175924} and completes the reward dialogue. This is the XP-paying end of the farm's object chain.

steps.title: Second Bulwark return
steps.note: Return to Vandis at the Bulwark. Turn in Dalson's report and take the third target, Writhing Haunt.

steps.title: Four Andorhal watchtowers
steps.note: Cross Andorhal on the way to Writhing Haunt. Use Derrington's Beacon Torch at each tower entrance until all four objectives are marked: Tower One 40.1,71.5; Tower Two 42.3,66.1; Tower Three 44.2,63.4; Tower Four 46.6,71.1. Clear access together and check every player's credit. Araj is not a required fight on this crossing.

steps.title: Writhing Haunt's cauldron keeper
steps.note: Continue east to Writhing Haunt and defeat Cauldron Lord Razarch. Loot the key for every player's quest, then use the farm's cauldron.

steps.title: Writhing Haunt cauldron interaction
steps.note: Each player finishes the cauldron target at the {object:176393} and accepts the third {quest:5234}. Visit {npc:10739} nearby before heading back west.

steps.title: {npc:10739}'s diseased wolves
steps.note: Speak with {npc:10739} in the Writhing Haunt farmhouse. The first wildlife quest asks for wolves; the bear quest only becomes available after this one is turned in.

steps.title: {npc:1817} circuit
steps.note: Kill the eight Diseased Wolves required by {npc:10739} in the central countryside north and west of Writhing Haunt. Stay within shared kill-credit range; this quest needs no personal item drops.

steps.title: {npc:10739}'s second wildlife assignment
steps.note: Return to {npc:10739} in the Writhing Haunt farmhouse. Hand in the wolves and accept his follow-up for Diseased Grizzlies.

steps.title: {npc:1816} circuit
steps.note: Kill the eight Diseased Grizzlies required by {npc:10739} in the countryside northeast of Writhing Haunt toward Gahrron's Withering. Check the exact creature name in the quest log so nearby wrong bear types do not waste kills.

steps.title: Carry {npc:10739}'s branch for later
steps.note: Return to {npc:10739}, finish the bear quest and accept {quest:4987}. Keep the branch and quest for {npc:5770} in {zone:1456} during chapter 8; there is no capital detour now.

steps.title: Third Bulwark return and tower reward
steps.note: Return west to the Bulwark. Report Writhing Haunt to Vandis and the four marked watchtowers to Derrington, then take Vandis's final cauldron target.

steps.title: Gahrron's final cauldron keeper
steps.note: Travel east to Gahrron's Withering and defeat Cauldron Lord Soulwrath together. This is the strongest of the four keepers, so pull with the full party ready and have everyone loot their own key.

steps.title: Gahrron's cauldron interaction
steps.note: Each player opens the {object:176392} and accepts the fourth {quest:5236}. This is the last required cauldron visit in the package.

steps.title: Fourth Bulwark return
steps.note: Return to Vandis at the Bulwark and finish Gahrron's report. Then speak with Derrington for {quest:5238}

steps.title: Mission accomplished and the eastern route
steps.note: Finish Derrington's final dialogue and reward. Keep {quest:4987} for chapter 8. The next chapter handles Unfinished Business on the Hearthglen trip and the {zone:1423} circuit; no kill-only grind is added at this boundary.

written.Carry {quest:5241} until the later Light: Carry Uncle Carlin until the later Light's Hope visit; first return west for Marlene and Chromie.
written.Cross into {zone:1423} and follow the Th: Cross into Eastern Plaguelands and follow the Thondroril River north to Tirion Fordring's isolated home. Pick up all three before killing wildlife. Carrion Grubbage is an explicit prerequisite exception: each player needs 15 meat, and a live 80% drop rate is not established. It unlocks Tirion's group event and later dungeon story.
written.Find {npc:11610} in the northern hills s: Find Kirsta in the northern hills south of Hearthglen. Her three quests require two actual returns before the final tower visit.
written.Recover the {item:12956} from Blackwood: Recover the Skull of Horgus from Blackwood Lake. Take nearby Plaguehounds and Frenzied Plaguehounds for Tirion while travelling through central and northern EPL.
written.Return west to Gahrron's Withering. The: Return west to Gahrron's Withering. The shield is a ground object at the farm; it is not in Darrowshire. Keep it while the group heads north for the libram and Kirsta's quests.
written.Speak to {npc:1855} again, follow the co: Speak to Tirion again, follow the conversation and let his account finish. Every player must receive their own quest credit.
written.Visit {npc:10927} in the house south of: Visit Marlene Redpath in the house south of Sorrow Hill before the first Eastern Plaguelands crossing. This chapter combines Darrowshire's fixed pickups, Kirsta's group circuit and Tirion's chain. Carry the capital deliveries from earlier chapters; the quest-log limit is 40.
written.{npc:11038} is at Light's Hope Chapel. K: Caretaker Alen is at Light's Hope Chapel. Keep Zaeldarr for the later Undercroft visit with Tirion's summoned enemy.
written.{npc:1855} before the eastern wildlife c: Tirion before the eastern wildlife circuit
written.{npc:1855} sends you to the artist: Tirion sends you to the artist

steps.title: {npc:10927} at Sorrow Hill
steps.note: Visit {npc:10927} in the house south of Sorrow Hill before the first {zone:1423} crossing. This chapter combines Darrowshire's fixed pickups, {npc:11610}'s group circuit and {npc:1855}'s chain. Carry the capital deliveries from earlier chapters; the quest-log limit is 40.

steps.title: {npc:1855} before the eastern wildlife circuit
steps.note: Cross into {zone:1423} and follow the Thondroril River north to {npc:1855}'s isolated home. Pick up all three before killing wildlife. {quest:5544} is an explicit prerequisite exception: each player needs 15 meat, and a live 80% drop rate is not established. It unlocks {npc:1855}'s group event and later dungeon story.

steps.title: Wildlife while travelling through the Plaguelands
steps.note: Kill Plaguebats and Plaguehound Runts across southern EPL; take Plaguehounds and Frenzied Plaguehounds when the route reaches central and northern EPL. Loot Carrion Grubs and Carrion Devourers for each player's meat. Stay in shared kill-credit range.

steps.title: {npc:10926} in Darrowshire
steps.note: Travel southeast to Darrowshire. {npc:10926} is beside the ruined house at the southwest side of the village.

steps.title: Reassemble {npc:10926}'s doll
steps.note: Search the ruined buildings for the head, left side and right side. Each player combines their three pieces into {quest:5149}. These fixed pickups are a chain-unlock exception if briefly contested; clear the nearby spirits together.

steps.title: {npc:10926}'s two introductions
steps.note: Carry {quest:5241} until the later Light's Hope visit; first return west for {npc:10927} and {npc:10667}.

steps.title: Joseph's grave
steps.note: Inspect Joseph Redpath's Monument in the Sorrow Hill graveyard. Loot {item:12894} before heading to Andorhal.

steps.title: {npc:10667}'s first visit
steps.note: {npc:10667} is upstairs in the inn at western Andorhal. This first visit is for the Darrowshire history chain; the level-53 temporal quest is deliberately later.

steps.title: Recover the Annals
steps.note: Enter Andorhal's town hall and search the books for the real {item:12900}. False books can spawn enemies. Stay together while every player secures the quest book; avoid pulling Araj's surrounding courtyard unnecessarily.

steps.title: {npc:11063} at Light's Hope Chapel
steps.note: Cross EPL to Light's Hope Chapel, progressing the wildlife objectives along the road. Deliver both introductions to {npc:11063} before accepting his two relic quests.

steps.title: {npc:11038}'s named target
steps.note: {npc:11038} is at Light's Hope Chapel. Keep Zaeldarr for the later Undercroft visit with {npc:1855}'s summoned enemy.

steps.title: Marduk's sword at the Infectis Scar
steps.note: Go to the Infectis Scar and take the {item:12957}. Gather the party before approaching the object; the pickup can trigger enemies.

steps.title: Horgus' skull at Blackwood Lake
steps.note: Recover the {item:12956} from Blackwood Lake. Take nearby Plaguehounds and Frenzied Plaguehounds for {npc:1855} while travelling through central and northern EPL.

steps.title: Redpath's shield in {zone:1422}
steps.note: Return west to Gahrron's Withering. The shield is a ground object at the farm; it is not in Darrowshire. Keep it while the group heads north for the libram and {npc:11610}'s quests.

steps.title: {npc:11610}
steps.note: Find {npc:11610} in the northern hills south of Hearthglen. Her three quests require two actual returns before the final tower visit.

steps.title: Clear the Scarlet approach
steps.note: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Mages and 2 Scarlet Knights on the approaches south of Hearthglen. Check each player's four counters before returning.

steps.title: Radley and Durgen
steps.note: Kill {npc:11613} around the eastern Scarlet approach and {npc:11611} farther north on the Hearthglen approach. Search their patrol areas as a group; if another party has just killed one, work the other objective before rechecking instead of standing at a spawn.

steps.title: Davil's libram in Hearthglen
steps.note: Enter Hearthglen together and collect {item:12954} inside the town hall. Keep pulls controlled; this area is higher than the lowest player's level. {item:12955} should already be in the bags.

steps.title: Climb the Scarlet watchtower
steps.note: Reach the top of Hearthglen's watchtower until every player's reconnaissance objective completes. This is a visit objective, not a requirement to clear the whole town.

steps.title: Finish {npc:1855}'s wildlife objectives
steps.note: Return east and finish only the missing counters: 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds, 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds, 30 Plaguebats and 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat per player. This is the end of the required collection exception, not an open-ended grind for a level.
steps.label: wildlife_finish

steps.title: Hear {npc:1855}'s account
steps.note: Speak to {npc:1855} again, follow the conversation and let his account finish. Every player must receive their own quest credit.

steps.title: Mercutio's summoned group
steps.note: Travel to Undercroft in southwest EPL. Gather all five at the Loose Dirt Mound, then disturb the grave. Defeat Mercutio and the accompanying enemies; each player must loot {item:14613} before leaving.

steps.title: Zaeldarr inside Undercroft
steps.note: Enter the crypt, defeat {quest:6021} and loot his head for each eligible player. Check the Torn Scroll behind him while already inside; Hameya's Plea needs level 54 and is a later-route pickup, not part of this chapter's XP.

goals.text: Optional future-chain check: /mappin 1423 22.90 72.97 marks the Torn Scroll. If level 54+ and available, inspect it; do not wait for a respawn or detour to finish Hameya in this chapter.

steps.title: The banner beneath Northdale's lake
steps.note: Recover the {item:14625} from the water at Northdale. This is a fixed object pickup, not a creature-drop grind. Make sure all five have it before riding south toward Light's Hope.

steps.title: Darrowshire relic rewards
steps.note: Return to {npc:11063} at Light's Hope Chapel. The route stops this branch after Heroes and Villains; later Darrowshire battle content is outside this pack.

steps.title: {npc:11936} at Caer Darrow
steps.note: Visit {npc:11936} in the small building on Caer Darrow's western shore. Deliver this stage only. Her Stratholme painting continuation belongs to a later dungeon guide and contributes no XP here.

goals.text: If you want the Stratholme continuation for the next guide, remember Renfray. Do not spend a quest-log slot on it yet unless your group is preparing that dungeon.

steps.title: Return to {npc:10667} at level 53 or above
steps.note: The earlier quest rewards are scheduled before this second visit so the lowest player can reach the level-53 requirement. If somebody is still below 53, review their missed turn-ins before proceeding; the guide does not prescribe filler grinding.

steps.title: Temporal Parasites at the grain silos
steps.note: Use the {item:12627} by Andorhal's grain silos. Defeat 15 Temporal Parasites together. Let each player confirm their quest counter; do not confuse older 10-kill versions with Forever's objective.

steps.title: {npc:270191} on the Thondroril River
steps.note: Head to the Thondroril River on the WPL/EPL boundary and inspect the {npc:270191} remains on the riverbank. This new Forever chain requires level 53. Each player must interact personally; {quest:7790} is not sharable. The starter's exact native-map pin is unverified, so use the visible quest marker and riverbank landmark.

steps.title: Follow the clues upstream
steps.note: Follow the river north toward the rapids and waterfall. Look along the right-hand bank while travelling upstream for the {npc:270307}'s remains. Interact to finish {quest:7790} and take the Mudsoaked Scrap. Every player accepts the next stage personally.

steps.title: {npc:16284} at Light's Hope
steps.note: Take the Mudsoaked Scrap to the {npc:16284} at the Light's Hope Chapel camp. The native quest marker is authoritative if the NPC is moved by a live update.

steps.title: The other Argent field camp
steps.note: Visit the {npc:16284} at the separate field camp northwest of Blackwood Lake. This is a different location from the Light's Hope medic, despite the identical name.

steps.title: {npc:11706} and the {zone:1454} hand-off
steps.note: Speak to {npc:11706} northwest of Northdale, beside the road toward Quel'Thalas. Accept the Horde follow-up and keep it for the capital reward circuit in chapter 8. This chapter's range is an estimate, not a grind requirement.

written.Find {npc:3978} on {zone:1456}'s lower c: Find Sage Truthseeker on Thunder Bluff's lower central rise and deliver Nara's message. Keep Magatha's payment to Jediga; its destination is Azshara in the final chapter.
written.Fly to {zone:1456} and visit {npc:5770}: Fly to Thunder Bluff and visit Nara Wildmane at Elder Rise. Turn in the branch from Mulgris and the Uldum report carried from Tanaris, then accept Nara's short local follow-up.

steps.title: Return to {zone:1454}
steps.note: Use the group's available hearth or the {zone:1458}-to-{zone:1454} zeppelin connection. This circuit cashes in work already completed; keep the three payments to Jediga for chapter 9. Quest-log capacity is 40, and these turn-ins will free several carried slots.

steps.title: Report the Alcaz findings to {npc:4949}
steps.note: {npc:4949} is inside Grommash Hold in the Valley of Wisdom. Deliver the report accepted after the Alcaz Prison chain; no repeat dungeon visit is needed.

steps.title: {npc:255679} and the river investigation
steps.note: Find {npc:255679} in the Valley of Wisdom. The pin marks her recorded patrol area, not a promise of a stationary NPC. Deliver the Horde ending of River Ends for its 6,000 base XP reward.

steps.title: {npc:3326} receives the demon proof
steps.note: {npc:3326} is in the Cleft of Shadow. Hand in the {quest:91548} proof obtained during the {zone:1419} chapter. The XP belongs to this city turn-in, not the earlier kill.

steps.title: {npc:5770} at Elder Rise
steps.note: Fly to {zone:1456} and visit {npc:5770} at Elder Rise. Turn in the branch from Mulgris and the Uldum report carried from {zone:1446}, then accept {npc:5770}'s short local follow-up.

steps.title: {npc:3978}
steps.note: Find {npc:3978} on {zone:1456}'s lower central rise and deliver {npc:5770}'s message. Keep Magatha's payment to Jediga; its destination is {zone:1447} in the final chapter.

steps.title: {npc:8579} at Steamwheedle Port
steps.note: Fly to Gadgetzan and ride to Steamwheedle Port. Bring the {item:10662} from the group's single Sunken Temple clear to {npc:8579}. This is the outstanding dungeon reward, not another Temple run.

steps.title: {npc:10302}'s temperature survey
steps.note: Enter Un'Goro and visit {npc:10302} beside the western lake. Each player must accept {quest:974} personally; it is not sharable. Keep the provided thermometer until the objective is complete.

steps.title: Fire Plume Ridge's hottest point
steps.note: Climb Fire Plume Ridge and use {npc:10541} at the hot spot near the summit. The pin is a recorded completion area; follow the terrain rather than trying to ride straight up the cliff. Each player uses their own thermometer until the quest completes.

steps.title: {npc:10302} sends you north
steps.note: Return to {npc:10302}, then accept {quest:980} for {npc:9298} in {zone:1452}. Continue to chapter 9 with the three payments to Jediga, A Final Blow, and {quest:980}. The 53-53 label describes this reward-heavy portion; there is no end-of-chapter grinding requirement.

written.Loot any {item:12558} that drops natural: Loot any Blue-feathered Necklace that drops naturally. It starts Guarding Secrets, with Trull as the first recipient; reports associate availability with the later Wild Guardians stages. Check it during these required kills and never extend the hunt just to obtain it.
written.Pass through Timbermaw Hold without atta: Pass through Timbermaw Hold without attacking the Timbermaw. Find Salfa immediately outside the Winterspring exit and accept his shared-kill quest before the first Winterfall camp. The Den Watchers overlap Donova's quest.
written.Return the shared-kill quest to {npc:929: Return the shared-kill quest to Donova. If a flask dropped naturally, you can inspect it and use this same visit for its opening delivery. The later Toxic Horrors collection is outside the core route.
written.Return to Bloodvenom Post for the final: Return to Bloodvenom Post for the final required reward. If a Blue-feathered Necklace dropped, inspect it and use this same Trull visit for the optional Guarding Secrets hand-in; its Thunder Bluff follow-up is outside this pack. The 53-54 range is an estimate, not a requirement to grind until the bar matches.
written.Return to {npc:10306} in {zone:1448} aga: Return to Trull in Felwood again. Hand in the 13 Moontouched kills and accept the separate 10 Berserk Owlbeast stage before travelling back to Winterspring.
written.Return west to {npc:9298} at the hot spr: Return west to Donova at the hot springs and report the Darkwhisper discovery. Then continue through Timbermaw for the second required Trull return.
written.Ride back to {npc:10922} at Emerald Sanc: Ride back to Greta at Emerald Sanctuary in southern Felwood and turn in the finale. Then head north toward Timbermaw Hold. This return is required for the reward; it is not a remote hand-in.
written.Search the hills north and northwest of: Search the hills north and northwest of Everlook once. Ursius patrols; the pin is a recorded sighting area. If present, kill him with the party. If absent, tick the search task and continue immediately; the next reward step only appears when already complete. If you kill him on a later pass, return to Storm separately or reopen the reward step manually.
written.Travel through {zone:1440} into {zone:14: Travel through Ashenvale into Felwood, using already learned flight paths where convenient. Pick up the first Wild Guardians stage from Trull at Bloodvenom Post before the northern circuit. Each stage returns here; the guide includes those real trips.
written.{npc:10306}'s final reward and pack fini: Trull's final reward and pack finish
written.{npc:10807} patrols the central and sout: Brumeran patrols the central and southern Winterspring hills. Search once while travelling between Everlook and Owl Wing Thicket. If absent, tick the search task and keep moving; the later reward step only appears when already complete. If you kill him after that step was skipped, return to Storm separately or reopen the reward step manually.

steps.title: Pay {npc:8587} at Valormok
steps.note: Travel north to Valormok in {zone:1447}. Deliver the three payments collected in {zone:1454}, {zone:1458} and {zone:1456} earlier in the pack. Keep {quest:5242} and {quest:980} for the next stops.

steps.title: {npc:10306} before entering {zone:1452}
steps.note: Travel through {zone:1440} into {zone:1448}, using already learned flight paths where convenient. Pick up the first {quest:4521} stage from {npc:10306} at Bloodvenom Post before the northern circuit. Each stage returns here; the guide includes those real trips.

steps.title: Finish Shadow Hold together
steps.note: Enter Shadow Hold at Jaedenar and descend to Shadow Lord Fel'dan's chamber. Kill {npc:9861} and {npc:9860}, then loot Fel'dan's head for every eligible player. The goal pin is the underground chamber's map position, not the cave entrance. This completes the quest accepted after the ward chain in chapter 4.

goals.text: If a {item:13140} drops during this clear, it can start the captured-elf rescue. Only take that optional escort if the captive and event are immediately available; no camping and no extra XP assumed.

steps.title: {npc:10922}'s final reward
steps.note: Ride back to {npc:10922} at Emerald Sanctuary in southern {zone:1448} and turn in the finale. Then head north toward Timbermaw Hold. This return is required for the reward; it is not a remote hand-in.

steps.title: {npc:11556} at the {zone:1452} tunnel exit
steps.note: Pass through Timbermaw Hold without attacking the Timbermaw. Find {npc:11556} immediately outside the {zone:1452} exit and accept his shared-kill quest before the first Winterfall camp. The Den Watchers overlap {npc:9298}'s quest.

steps.title: {npc:9298} at Frostfire Hot Springs
steps.note: Visit {npc:9298} southwest of the tunnel exit. Deliver Krakle's message and accept both the furbolg kills and the later southern exploration. {quest:5082} does not require the old Trouble in {zone:1452} breadcrumb.

steps.title: Owlbeasts and furbolgs along the first circuit
steps.note: Work the Ragged Owlbeasts between western {zone:1452} and Everlook, then the Raging Owlbeasts north and northwest of Everlook. {quest:8464} finishes later at Winterfall Village; its Den Watchers can be credited in the western camps now.

steps.title: Western Winterfall camps
steps.note: Clear the camps near Timbermaw's exit and east of the hot springs. Kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Den Watchers and 8 Totemics. The same 8 Den Watchers count for {npc:11556} if both quests are active; nobody needs individual drops for these objectives.

goals.text: Keep a naturally dropped {item:12771} for Winterfall Firewater, and a {item:20742} for its item-start quest. The totem's recipient Kernda requires Neutral Timbermaw. Neither starter is farmed or included in the XP forecast.

steps.title: {npc:9298}'s first reward
steps.note: Return the shared-kill quest to {npc:9298}. If a flask dropped naturally, you can inspect it and use this same visit for its opening delivery. The later Toxic Horrors collection is outside the core route.

steps.title: Ragged Owlbeasts on the road east
steps.note: Progress {quest:4521} while crossing central {zone:1452}. Finish the 15 Ragged Owlbeasts before spending time on their higher-level relatives around Everlook.

steps.title: {npc:10303} at Everlook
steps.note: Visit {npc:10303} in Everlook and accept the first named hunt. {npc:10806} and its follow-up {npc:10807} are availability-sensitive bonus rewards: make one search circuit and move on if absent. The main five-level model has a buffer for missing both hunts.

goals.text: Optional next-guide pickups in Everlook: The Everlook Report and Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff. They require a later {zone:1415} trip; no delivery XP is counted in this pack. Keep free space within the 40-slot log.

steps.title: Raging Owlbeasts near Everlook
steps.note: Kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts north and northwest of Everlook, watching for {npc:10806} while you are already in the area. Do not substitute Ragged, Crazed or Moontouched Owlbeasts for this counter.

steps.title: One {npc:10806} search circuit
steps.note: Search the hills north and northwest of Everlook once. {npc:10806} patrols; the pin is a recorded sighting area. If present, kill him with the party. If absent, tick the search task and continue immediately; the next reward step only appears when already complete. If you kill him on a later pass, return to {npc:10303} separately or reopen the reward step manually.

goals.text: Finish one {npc:10806} search circuit, then continue whether he was present or absent.

steps.title: Winterfall Village
steps.note: Go to Winterfall Village east of Everlook. Finish {npc:11556}'s 8 Winterfall Shamans and 8 {npc:7438}; the 8 Den Watchers should already be credited from the western camps. These are higher-level enemies, so pull as five.

goals.text: Named starter check: {npc:10738}, /mappin 1452 69.56 38.31. The {item:12842} starts The Final Piece, but eligibility depends on Winterfall Firewater progress. Do not assume an unconditional starter, wait for him, or begin the poor-drop prerequisite chain for this route.

steps.title: Claim {npc:10806} only if completed
steps.note: Return to {npc:10303} in Everlook. Only players who completed {npc:10806} receive this reward. The guide safely omits this step when {npc:10806} was absent.

steps.title: {npc:10303}'s second named hunt
steps.note: After {npc:10806} is turned in, accept {npc:10807} for the later southern circuit. This separate step remains eligible after {npc:10806} leaves the quest log. If {npc:10806} was absent, {npc:10807} is omitted as well.

steps.title: Finish the first owlbeast counter
steps.note: Check that the first {quest:4521} stage has all 15 Raging and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts before leaving {zone:1452}. Only finish missing quest counters; no level target or filler grinding is attached to this check.
steps.label: first_circuit_finish

steps.title: {npc:11556}'s reward at the tunnel
steps.note: Return to {npc:11556} at the western tunnel exit. If a Ritual Totem dropped naturally and you are already Neutral, Kernda is inside Timbermaw Hold at /mappin 1452 25.46 32.43; take the optional hand-in on this existing journey without a reputation grind.

steps.title: Bloodvenom return for the second stage
steps.note: Return to {npc:10306} at Bloodvenom Post. The next owlbeast counter cannot progress before this hand-in and acceptance. Use the Everlook/Bloodvenom flight connection if learned and available, otherwise travel through Timbermaw Hold.

steps.title: Southern {zone:1452} owlbeasts
steps.note: Return to {zone:1452}, then go southeast of Everlook toward Owl Wing Thicket. Kill 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts. The recorded completion area is in the south despite the quest's broad directional description. Keep {npc:10807} and the Darkwhisper exploration on this same southern circuit.

steps.title: One {npc:10807} search circuit
steps.note: {npc:10807} patrols the central and southern {zone:1452} hills. Search once while travelling between Everlook and Owl Wing Thicket. If absent, tick the search task and keep moving; the later reward step only appears when already complete. If you kill him after that step was skipped, return to {npc:10303} separately or reopen the reward step manually.

goals.text: Finish one {npc:10807} search circuit, then continue whether he was present or absent.

steps.title: Discover Darkwhisper Gorge
steps.note: Follow the southern road across the bridge into the Darkwhisper approach. Advance only until {quest:4842} completes. The objective is discovery; it does not require fighting the elite demons deeper inside the gorge.

steps.title: Claim {npc:10807} only if completed
steps.note: Take the completed named hunt to {npc:10303} in Everlook. Skip later named-hunt follow-ups here; they are not part of the five-level route.

steps.title: {npc:9298}'s exploration reward
steps.note: Return west to {npc:9298} at the hot springs and report the Darkwhisper discovery. Then continue through Timbermaw for the second required {npc:10306} return.

steps.title: Bloodvenom return for the last stage
steps.note: Return to {npc:10306} in {zone:1448} again. Hand in the 13 Moontouched kills and accept the separate 10 {npc:7454} stage before travelling back to {zone:1452}.

steps.title: Berserk Owlbeasts and the necklace check
steps.note: Hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in northeastern {zone:1452}, north of Winterfall Village. They are level 58-59 enemies, so remain together. The pin marks a recorded spawn area, not a single guaranteed spawn.

goals.text: Loot any {item:12558} that drops naturally. It starts Guarding Secrets, with {npc:10306} as the first recipient; reports associate availability with the later {quest:4721} stages. Check it during these required kills and never extend the hunt just to obtain it.

steps.title: {npc:10306}'s final reward and pack finish
steps.note: Return to Bloodvenom Post for the final required reward. If a {item:12558} dropped, inspect it and use this same {npc:10306} visit for the optional Guarding Secrets hand-in; its {zone:1456} follow-up is outside this pack. The 53-54 range is an estimate, not a requirement to grind until the bar matches.

goals.text: All scheduled core chains now finish here. An unavailable {npc:10806} or {npc:10807} hunt may remain in your log for later; neither requires camping. Their combined 12,000 base quest XP is an availability-sensitive allowance. Keep optional future-dungeon or courier quests only if you want them.
